connector.name: Second Eyes Agent Workflow Services
connector.registryDescription: Workflow diagnostics, capability routing, and x402 settlement for MCP-compatible agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at secondeyesai.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-unblock. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the this-is-hellgate account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MCP_X402_WALLET_KEY
env.description: EVM private key (0x…) for auto USDC payment on 402. SECURITY: MCP process can drain this wallet — use a dedicated low-balance payer.

env.name: MCP_X402_ALLOW_SLUGS
env.description: Comma-separated capability slugs allowed for compatibility auto-pay. Default (unset) or * enables every zero-argument capability priced at or below $0.05 USDC. Input-requiring transcription and extraction routes remain excluded unless explicitly selected. Spending caps remain authoritative.
